scope: Independent incremental server package: unchanged old auth plus new shared authority on real Fastify.listen/TCP loopback and PostgreSQL17. Production clocks apply to 17 HTTP cases; one HTTP case and one PG clock case explicitly inject isolated authority wall/monotonic sources. Nonempty seal, expired permit/proof and rollback use isolation only. No relay, complete FileCarry, physical device, native OfflineGrace, dual-client relay chain or LAN deployment acceptance.
